description: This file defines the interface for a PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) processor supporting multiple formats (0 to 4) in a 3GPP LTE/NR system. It includes configuration structures for each format, a processor interface with virtual methods for processing each format, and a validator interface for configuration validation.

classes.name: ocudu::pucch_processor
classes.description: Interface for processing various PUCCH formats, including configuration structures and processing methods.

classes.name: ocudu::pucch_pdu_validator
classes.description: Interface for validating PUCCH configuration parameters.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a PUCCH message of a specific format given resource grid and configuration.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Validates a specific PUCCH configuration structure.
